# Pallotta Pavers &amp; Concrete LLC

> Paver and concrete contractor based in Dade City, Florida, serving Pasco County and north Hillsborough County. Over 30 years in the trade. Licensed in Pasco County (C.C # LC-009985), insured and bonded.

Family-run business owned by Paul Pallotta, a second generation cement mason. Work covers interlocking pavers and poured concrete for homes and commercial sites: patios, driveways, walkways, pool decks, retaining walls, steps, fire pits, RV pads, garage floors, building slabs, sidewalks, seamless texture concrete and parking lots.

## Service areas

Pasco County, Northern Hillsborough County, San Antonio, Zephyrhills, Dade City, Land O' Lakes, Wesley Chapel, Spring Hill, Brooksville, Lutz, Odessa.

## Notes

- Free consultation and quote on request.
- Quotes are estimates confirmed after an in-person site visit.
- Concrete and paver work is weather dependent; scheduling may shift to protect the quality of the installation.
